{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Heff}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:Heff-Tobber-helmetless-SWCT.png]] |name=Heff Tobber |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Pilots of the Rebel Alliance}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] **[[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Copy, Blue Leader!|Heff Tobber responds to General Antoc Merrick|audio=Tobber-Copy-RogueOne.flac|''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''}} [[Lieutenant]] '''Heff Tobber''' was a [[human]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who initially served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[transport]] [[pilot]] for their [[Crait outpost|rebel outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Crait]]. After helping to [[Evacuation of Crait base|evacuate]] the base when it was abandoned, he transferred to [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] and trained with [[X-wing starfighter]]s before beginning to pilot [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]]s. Tobber became an expert U-wing pilot and was popular and highly sought after due to his humor and booming voice. In [[1 BBY]], Blue Squadron was scrambled to aid [[Rogue One|rebels]] [[Battle of Scarif|stealing]] the [[Death Star plans]] on the planet [[Scarif]]. Tobber flew an [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] under the [[callsign]] [[Blue Eight]] during the engagement, in which the [[squadron]] was sent to the planet's surface through a [[Shield Gate]]; however, he was not among the pilots that made it through before the gate shut. Determined to still do his part, he then joined the rebel [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] in [[starfighter combat]]. Although Blue Squadron took heavy casualties in the battle, some who survived returned to Yavin once the plans had been successfully stolen. ==Biography== ===Clearing Crait=== {{Quote|General, as you know I assisted in the evacuation of Crait base. Though we abandoned it in a hurry, we left most of its facilities intact in the hope of returning at a later date with heavy transport equipment.|Heff Tobber, in a report to Jan Dodonna|''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''}} Heff Tobber was a [[human]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and initially contributed to the effort by acting as a [[transport]] [[pilot]] and carrying various materials and supplies to the modest [[Crait outpost|rebel outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Crait]] where he was stationed. When the base was hurriedly [[Evacuation of Crait base|abandoned]] between [[3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]],Heff Tobber's report in ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' is placed between documentation covering the [[mission on Lothal]] and the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]], respectively. Tobber assisted in the evacuation. He and the other rebels left most of the facilities, including the locked down and powered off comms station and a garage full of [[V-4X-D ski speeder|skim speeders]], intact with the hopes of returning to salvage them at a later date with heavy transport equipment. [[File:Heff_Tobber_U-Wing_XWM.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A blue-striped U-wing flies low over a tropical beach with a line of palm trees visible in the distance. Military debris is scattered across the beach and two columns of smoke rise in the distance.|Tobber was one of the most popular rebel U-wing pilots but could also pilot an X-wing.]] Tobber was transferred to the [[Massassi Group]] of rebels based out of the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] and became part of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]], a large, mixed [[starfighter]] [[squadron]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]]. Tobber initially trained in [[X-wing starfighter]]s but was then transferred to [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] the Alliance's newly acquired [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Weapons & Uniforms}} and became one of the most popular U-wing pilots around due to his sense of humor and booming voice, earning renown{{EncyclopediaCite|The Saga of Rey}} and the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. After joining Blue Squadron, Tobber sent a report on the evacuation of the Crait base to General [[Jan Dodonna]] of [[Alliance High Command]], outlining the state the base was left in and dismissing concerns about [[scavenger]]s due to how secure and uncharted the location was. This report was later included in the collection of non-electronic documents known as ''[[The Rebel Files]]''. ===The Battle of Scarif=== {{Quote|Blue Squadron, get to the surface before they close that gate.|Raddus|audio=Raddus-BlueSquadron.flac|}} Shortly after part of Blue Squadron was sent on a [[Mission to Eadu|mission]] to the planet [[Eadu]] in [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]]. Tobber was scrambled, along with the entirety of the squadron, to join an [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance fleet]] led by [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] that was traveling to the [[Scarif system]]. This was to aid a [[Rogue One|group]] of rebels who had defied a decision by the [[Alliance Cabinet]] and infiltrated the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Citadel Tower]] on the planet [[Scarif]] to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. [[File:BlueSquadronPilot-R1.jpg|thumb|left|300px|alt=Heff Tobber, wearing a red and white stripped flight helmet and a blue flight suit, sits in the cockpit of an X-wing starfighter.|Heff Tobber flew as Blue Eight during the Battle of Scarif.]] Tobber flew under the [[callsign]] [[Blue Eight]] in an [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing starfighter]] during the engagement and, upon arriving in the Scarif [[Star system|system]] from [[hyperspace]], he and the rest of Blue Squadron were directed by Raddus to head to Scarif's surface before the Empire closed its [[Shield Gate]], the sole opening in a [[planetary shield]] around the world. Before they began their descent, Merrick gave the order to follow his lead, with Tobber among those who acknowledged the order. ===Entry denied=== {{Quote|Pull up!''"
[Grek screams]|quoteend=0|Barion Raner and others pull away from the Shield Gate as Vangos Grek crashes into it|audio=Raner-Grek.flac|}} As Blue Squadron began diving through the [[Golan M3185 space station|Shield Gate]], the Imperial crew on board the gate began to close it before all of the rebel starfighters could make it through. After Merrick's craft and eleven other X-wings, plus a U-wing piloted by [[Laren Joma]], made it through, the gate fully sealed, causing [[Vangos Grek]] and two other Blue Squadron X-wing pilots to crash into it and [[Death|perish]]. Tobber, alongside [[Jaldine Gerams]], [[Barion Raner]], and at least one other pilot, did not make it through in [[time]] but safely pulled away before a collision. [[File:RanerEscapes-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Three X-wings fly toward a Star Destroyer, with a second destroyer visible in the distance against the backdrop of space.|Heff Tobber was among the pilots who were trapped outside the Shield Gate after it closed.]] Separated from their squadron, the Blue Squadron pilots outside the shield joined the rest of the Alliance [[fleet]] in battling the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial fleet]] above Scarif, with Tobber joining the X-wings of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] in [[Starfighter combat|orbital combat]] against enemy [[TIE series|fighters]].''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' The Alliance fleet eventually succeeded in destroying the Shield Gate and powering down the planetary shield, allowing the rebels on the ground to transmit the [[Death Star]] plans to the fleet; however, all of the Blue Squadron pilots who had passed through the gate perished during the fighting or when the Death Star itself arrived and destroyed the Citadel Tower.{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Weapons & Uniforms}} Some of the remaining Blue Squadron pilots did escape with the rebel fleet and returned to Yavin following the battle, but between Eadu and Scarif, Blue and [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadrons]] had lost nineteen pilots and crew between them. So few Blue Squadron pilots were left that when the Death Star then [[Battle of Yavin|attacked]] Yavin,{{StoryCite|story=Duty Roster|book=From a Certain Point of View}} not long after Scarif, the Alliance was unsure if it could even field the squadron and ultimately only scrambled Red Squadron, Green Squadron, and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]].''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I'm not worried about scavengers. The system's coordinates aren't on any chart, and even if the old mining company left its logs somewhere, the base itself is a vault. Fusioncutters won't take a chip out of that durasteel gate, and the rest of the base sits in the heart of a mountain.|Heff Tobber, in a report to Jan Dodonna|}} Heff Tobber had a booming voice and a good sense of humor that made him extremely popular with the [[soldier]]s that he transported. After evacuating the Crait base, he was confident it would remain unscavenged, and after failing to pass through the Shield Gate at Scarif, he was determined to still play his part in the battle and had to settle for supporting Green Squadron. Tobber had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. ==Skills and abilities== Tobber was at ease flying an X-wing starfighter, and could do so when circumstances required, but turned his skills toward piloting a U-wing. His previous experience running transport vehicles then helped him become an expert, making him one of the most sought-after and prominent U-wing pilots in the rebellion. ==Equipment== [[File:HeffTobberHelmet-ROUVG.png|thumb|left|250px|alt=The black and red U-wing flight helmet worn by Heff Tobber.||Heff Tobber's U-wing flight helmet]] As part of Blue Squadron, Tobber wore a blue [[flight suit]], a white [[flight harness]], and a white [[flak vest]]. His U-wing piloting outfit then included a white [[high-atmosphere specialist life support pack]] worn over the vest and a black and red [[flight helmet]] with an integral [[comlink]] and [[intercom]] link. The [[helmet]] was marked with a yellow [[victory decal]]{{SW|url=games-apps/rogue-one-helmet-creator|text=''Rogue One'' Helmet Creator|int=Rogue One Helmet Creator|nolive=1}} and then two red victory decals on each side, marks that fellow rebel pilot [[Wion Dillems]] used to represent twenty enemy kills. While piloting an X-wing during the Battle of Scarif, Tobber instead wore a gray [[Diagnostech life support unit]] and a [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] with a red and white chequered pattern that also decorated the helmets of fellow rebel pilots Dillems, [[Puck Naeco]],{{Film|IV}} and [[Wes Janson]].{{Databank|wes-janson|Wes Janson}} ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|This is Toby Hefferman, first assistant director on Rogue One. He had originally dressed up as a U-wing pilot that was cut, but later on after growing an impressive mustache, shot this X-wing scene, meaning there's photography of 'Heff Tobber' as both.|Pablo Hidalgo|{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/1740106108579271076|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2023-12-27|quote=This is Toby Hefferman, first assistant director on Rogue One. He had originally dressed up as a U-wing pilot that was cut, but later on after growing an impressive mustache, shot this X-wing scene, meaning there's photography of 'Heff Tobber' as both.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/7aurk}}}} [[File:TobyHefferman-Variety.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A promotional photo of Toby Hefferman.|Heff Tobber was portrayed by First Assistant Director Toby Hefferman.]] Heff Tobber was created for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', and was portrayed by the film's First Assistant Director, [[Toby Hefferman]]. Hefferman initially wore a U-wing pilot costume that was cut other than its use in still photography but, after growing a much thicker mustache, Hefferman later wore a different rebel pilot outfit to film a scene as an X-wing pilot that was included in the final cut. The character was identified with a [[tuckerization]] of Hefferman's name in the film's accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and alluded to Tobber appearing as both an X-wing and U-wing pilot. Hidalgo also later confirmed that Hefferman's U-wing and X-wing costumes both represented the same character. The [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 71|seventy-first issue]] of the [[De Agostini]] magazine ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]''—released [[August 1]], [[2017]]{{HCdatesFR|71}} and written by [[Iain Lowson]]{{EmailCite|email=File:HCSV-Email-2025-07-26.png|author=[[Iain Lowson]]|date=2025-07-26}}—erroneously describes Tobber as flying a U-wing at Scarif despite him being depicted in a X-wing in the film. In the [[2022]] non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', published by [[Traveller's Tales]], a rumor mission in the outpost on Crait is titled "Tobber's Treasure." The mission occurs during the [[Battle of Crait]]''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' in [[34 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' when the [[Resistance]], successor to the Rebel Alliance, are using the base. Players receive the rumor by talking to a civilian Resistance member in base's cave passages who points out a [[kyber brick]] on a ledge on the opposite wall of the cavern. They tell the player that they have no idea how the brick got there but that the player is welcome to it if they can reach it. The player must then shoot a [[spider]]'s web covering a grapple point above the brick which can then be used to reach the brick and complete the mission. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Heff Tobber}} *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Heff Tobber}} *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Ultimate Sticker Encyclopedia]]'' *{{FFGXW|set=U-wing Expansion Pack|cardname=Heff Tobber}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Weapons & Uniforms}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' *{{FFGXW2|set=Rebel Alliance Conversion Kit|cardname=Heff Tobber}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Saga of Rey}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Pilots of the Rebel Alliance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Heff Tobber |es=Heff Tobber |fr=Heff Tobber |ja=ヘフ・トバー |pl=Heff Tobber }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Tobber, Heff}} [[Category:Alliance Starfighter Corps officers]] [[Category:Blue Squadron personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
